comparators.pollingOnly: frozen statewide poll ALP/Coalition binary event
comparators.pollingPlusFundamentals: mean of the same frozen poll and 2014 baseline
comparators.seatLevel: district winner probability transformed to an ALP event
comparators.completeEnsemble: frozen v1 district ALP win probability

caveat: The seat-level and complete-ensemble ALP-event comparator outputs are numerically identical in v1 because both consume the same frozen district probabilities; they are retained as labelled protocol outputs, not independent evidence.
